notReleased.Cargo.toml: the root Cargo workspace of the core crate and the binding crates (binding design L-2)
notReleased.composer.json: the private development root of packages/php, which resolves the packages from the checkout
notReleased.examples/board/composer.json: the example application, which installs the packages from the checkout
notReleased.packages/go/go.mod: a binding package of binding, which binding scaffold writes; it is released after the generated bindings pass the contract and the package tests and kit makes its platform assets
notReleased.packages/go/internal/ffi/Cargo.toml: a binding package of binding, which binding scaffold writes; it is released after the generated bindings pass the contract and the package tests and kit makes its platform assets
notReleased.packages/php/native/Cargo.toml: a binding package of binding, which binding scaffold writes; it is released after the generated bindings pass the contract and the package tests and kit makes its platform assets
notReleased.packages/php/native/composer.json: a binding package of binding, which binding scaffold writes; it is released after the generated bindings pass the contract and the package tests and kit makes its platform assets
notReleased.packages/python/native/Cargo.toml: a binding package of binding, which binding scaffold writes; it is released after the generated bindings pass the contract and the package tests and kit makes its platform assets
notReleased.packages/rust/Cargo.toml: the core crate polyspec-hyper, publish = false: the bindings that packages/rust/interface.json generates build it from the source of the checkout, and no runtime installs it alone
notReleased.packages/ts/native/Cargo.toml: a binding package of binding, which binding scaffold writes; it is released after the generated bindings pass the contract and the package tests and kit makes its platform assets
notReleased.scripts/recipe/typescript/package.json: the private install of the TypeScript compiler API that the Node reader of the recipe check reads
notReleased.tests/package-install/package.json: the test package that installs the npm archives of the packages
